note: Beaver Creek Valley State Park campground strung along the road in the steep, wooded valley of East Beaver Creek, a trout stream, near Caledonia. Vehicles that don't fit a site's gravel spur go to the picnic parking lot, not the grass. --Claude
summary: DNR park record and ReserveMN read: 42 drive-in sites, but only 26 take an RV (16 electric 30-amp at 35-55 ft, 10 non-electric at 30-45 ft); sites 27-42 are drive-in tent-only past a water crossing, plus 9 cart-in (stored note said 6). Season April 1 - November 8. Stored count 48 -> 26. Fees left as stored ($20/$30, the same on ReserveMN for June 2027). Pin ~520 m off on the bluff.

Base fee $20 is a non-electric RV site (17-26, 30-45 ft), so a 23-ft rig fits it; the $20 tent-only sites 27-42 do not set it.
